name: Begusarai

queries.query: बेगूसराय बिहार भू नक्शा जमीन का नक्शा आधिकारिक कैडस्ट्रल GIS
queries.scope: Find the official Begusarai municipal cadastral map and check for public full-polygon queries.
queries.result: Official Bihar BhuNaksha map offers public district/subdivision/circle/mauza selectors and a map/plot interface. State=10 selector responses identify Begusarai district code 20 with data, and subdivision/circle Begusarai code 01 with data. The viewer JavaScript uses WMS image layers and a plot-selection flow; no full vector geometry endpoint/response was verified for the queued urban point.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

queries.query: Begusarai Bihar official cadastral parcel map BhuNaksha GIS full geometry API
queries.scope: Cross-check official land records and anonymous map response schema.
queries.result: Bihar BhuNaksha is maintained by the state Directorate of Land Records & Survey/NIC and exposes cadastral map selection. Its map shell renders WMS image layers; no anonymous complete GeoJSON parcel response was identified. The selected mauza example had null extent and is not evidence at the queued city point.
queries.executionMethod: Official source search plus read-only inspection of anonymous public map/service routes.

portals.name: BhuNaksha Bihar
portals.operator: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; National Informatics Centre
portals.observation: Public cadastral map viewer with State, District, Sub Div, Circle, Mauza, Survey Type, Map Instance and Sheet selectors. Official intro describes digital cadastral maps and the Government of Bihar land-records data source.

portals.name: Begusarai district land-records page
portals.observation: Official district page links the state land-record service.

requests.observation: Anonymous public map shell returned successfully.
Viewer script shows OpenLayers ImageWMS map layers and selection through raster WMS; it does not expose a complete-feature vector query in the inspected route.
State=10 district list contains Begusarai code 20 with hasData=true; hierarchy reports Begusarai subdivision and circle code 01 with hasData=true.
For one Begusarai circle/mauza selection, viewer returned administrative attribution and a GIS code but null extent coordinates; this example is not bound to the queued city point.

source.name: BhuNaksha Bihar public cadastral map viewer
source.operator: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar; National Informatics Centre
source.serviceType: Public hierarchical map viewer with WMS image overlays and plot-selection/report functions. Full public vector geometry response not verified.
source.layer: Selected village cadastral map; no city-wide feature layer or vector schema confirmed.
source.geometryType: Map image only in observed viewer route; full polygon response not obtained.
source.outputCrs: Not established for a full geometry response.
source.nativeIdField: Plot/survey number is a viewer search input; no public geometry record response obtained.
source.nativeIdEvidence: Selector metadata confirms Begusarai district and subdivisions with map data; no exact feature identity returned at the queued point.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: State cadastral mapping application supports Bihar district and village map selection; Begusarai selector hierarchy reports data available.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public map interface and hierarchy verified. No city-located full feature geometry retrieved; one individual mauza extent response was null and was not treated as a city-point result.

technicalBlocker: The official viewer’s inspected map path uses WMS image layers; an anonymous complete vector geometry response was not found. The map hierarchy alone does not confirm the queued city point’s coverage.
remainingUncertainty: Whether a separately documented public vector endpoint exists, whether central Begusarai urban maps are digitized in BhuNaksha, and which mauza includes the queued WUP point.
nextStep: If continuing, identify the exact urban mauza/map instance at the WUP point and check only documented public vector routes; do not infer city geometry from district selectors or WMS pixels.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Official cadastral viewer exists, but no complete public polygon, exact identity/absence semantics or queued-point coverage verified.

registryBasis: The official DILRMP sub-registrar report names DSRO Begusarai; the local district-administration page names its Begusarai land-reforms and registration offices and gives the Collectorate location in Begusarai city. This confirms city-located registration/land-record institutions. The district Land Records link separately names Patna and is not used as city evidence. Public full parcel polygons remain unverified.
